title: Build and verify Predictive Survival for Minecraft 26.1.2
objective: Implement the approved standalone client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft Java 26.1.2 that predicts observable incoming damage with vanilla-faithful semantics and executes the safest server-valid survival action before lethal damage is processed.
acceptance_criteria: The project builds for Minecraft Java 26.1.2 on Java 25 with pinned Fabric dependencies and no Yarn mappings
The deterministic damage and timeline core matches source-confirmed vanilla ordering including hurt cooldown, mitigation, absorption, blocking, and death protection
Observable vanilla damage families have predictors or an explicit documented reason they cannot be forecast before impact
Lethal predicted events equip a death-protection item into a server-recognized hand before the conservative deadline when feasible
The planner evaluates server-valid non-totem survival actions through the same timeline simulation and never relies on client-only desync or impossible movement
Shield warmup, inventory resynchronization, multi-hit sequences, explosion exposure, and bypass tags are covered by deterministic tests
Experimental deliberate hurt-cooldown manipulation remains disabled until exact-runtime evidence proves a specific tactic beneficial and server-valid
GitHub Actions builds/tests the project and exact-runtime validation results are documented honestly before completion
